title: Boolean functions depending on at most one coordinate
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{-1,1\\}$ depend on at most one coordinate; that is, there is a set of at most one coordinate on which its value depends. Then either $f$ is constantly $1$, constantly $-1$, or there is a coordinate $i$ such that $f(x)=x_i$ for every $x$, or $f(x)=-x_i$ for every $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ depends on a set of at most one coordinate
